title: Angela Rayner ‘clear she followed rules’ when buying Hove flat, says Bridget Phillipson
summary: Education secretary defends her cabinet colleague against claims she avoided stamp duty when buying property Bridget Phillipson has defended her cabinet colleague Angela Rayner over accusations the deputy prime minister avoided tax when buying a seaside property in East Sussex. The education secretary said Rayner had the right to buy the £800,000 flat in Hove “so long as she followed all the rules”, after reports Rayner had avoided £40,000 in stamp duty by listing it as the only property she owns.
